product_metadata.title: White Sage Smudge Kit with Shell, Stand, and Charcoal
description: Smudge set that includes: One California 8-9" White sage wand, one hand-made wooden 8" tripod, one 5-6" abalone shell, and one roll (10 tablets) of 33mm Three Kings charcoal. Packaged in a plain box.
